name: 500 KL RCC elevated storage reservoir, coastal — TWAD Board 07/2026
domain: civil — reinforced concrete, water-retaining structure, severe exposure
notes: Planted: 40 mm cover below the 45 mm required for severe exposure; superseded cement standard IS 12269 (now IS 269:2015); IS 456 amendments; no conformity evidence for steel and cement. M30, w/c 0.45 and 320 kg/m3 are compliant for severe exposure. IS 3370 is not in the corpus, so nothing can be said about it. IS 456 is cited twice; a reviewer needs the amendment reminder only once.

requirements.text: The reservoir is located within 2 km of the sea coast.
The structure shall be designed for the exposure condition "severe" as defined in IS 456:2000.
Design of the container shall be based on IS 3370 (Part 2) for liquid retaining structures.
The contractor shall submit the structural design and drawings, vetted by a reputed engineering college, for approval before commencement of work.
Cement shall be ordinary Portland cement 53 grade conforming to IS 12269.
Coarse and fine aggregates shall conform to IS 383:2016.
The nominal maximum size of coarse aggregate shall be 20 mm.
Reinforcement shall be Fe 500D TMT bars conforming to IS 1786:2008.
Water used for mixing and curing shall be clean and free from injurious amounts of oils, acids and salts.
All RCC work for the container, staging and foundation shall be of grade M30.
Concrete shall be designed mix, proportioned as per IS 10262:2019.
Minimum cement content shall be 320 kg/m3.
The free water-cement ratio shall not exceed 0.45.
Nominal cover to reinforcement shall be 40 mm for all members.
Concrete shall be mixed in a batching plant and placed with a concrete pump.
Concrete shall be compacted with needle vibrators.
Curing shall be done for a minimum period of 14 days.
Grade of concrete: M30
Exposure condition: severe
Maximum water-cement ratio: 0.45
Minimum cement content: 320 kg/m3
Slump: 75 mm to 100 mm
Cube samples shall be taken as per the frequency specified in IS 456:2000.
Compressive strength tests shall be carried out as per IS 516 (Part 1/Sec 1):2021.
The container shall be tested for water tightness by filling it to full supply level for 7 days.
Any leakage observed during the test shall be rectified by the contractor at his own cost.
The reservoir shall be provided with lightning arrester, aluminium ladder and railing.
All exposed surfaces shall be painted with two coats of anti-carbonation paint.
The contractor shall maintain a site register of all tests conducted.

findings.why: 40 mm < 45 mm minimum nominal cover for severe exposure.
IS 12269 (53 grade OPC) is superseded by IS 269:2015.
Amendments to IS 456:2000 should be confirmed.
Reinforcement (IS 1786) and cement (IS 269) have a BIS certification route but no conformity evidence is asked for.
